purpose: F28 of the fifth independent review (L-0220): the END-state test of the third fix returned silently while evidence/pins.json was missing, so the runner printed a plain ok (1 ms, # skipped 0) for a test that asserted nothing. end-state-skip.test.cjs runs each END-state test file in a scratch copy of the namespace without pins.json and requires the TAP to say `# SKIP <reason>` and `# skipped 1`, never a plain ok. It runs here against the PUBLISHED bytes of the third-fix test (evidence/red/prefix-35b21507), which prints the plain ok: that test must fail, the fourth-fix file and the controls pass.
